text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on (Monday, Tuesday, etc): NEUE ZUERCHER ZEITUNG - Advertising in the Swiss press decreased in first half of 1997, just as in the first half of 1996. The volume of ads in daily and weekly newspapers fel, 6.8 percent. - Job-ads in daily newspapers again rose in June. The job index rose 0.1 points in June to 35.2 points from May. TAGES ANZEIGER - In the consultation process for a new law on medication, doctors and pharmacists critisise that there will no longer be any price fixing. They say the new law, which permits discounts and drugs being sent by mail, could be dangerous. - The rainy and cold weather is frustrating the organisers of the Zurich open air cinema and swimming baths. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
